title: SNP Insights report IR
description: Structured intermediate representation of the Stage 3 narrative. The LLM produces this; a deterministic renderer turns it into prose. Every claim must cite a resolvable finding_id + field_path from findings.json. No free-floating assertions.

generated_by.description: Who wrote the claim text: 'template' (fixed templates only) or 'model' (a language model wrote at least one sentence). Absent means 'model' for the notice.

findings_hash.description: sha256 hex of the exact findings.json this report was generated from

finding_id.description: A finding_id from findings.json, or the literal 'provenance'

field_path.description: Dot notation into the cited object, e.g. 'evidence.clinvar.review_stars'

caveat_ids.description: Caveats drawn from the registry; renderer expands them. 'array_limits' is mandatory per section.

contradiction_ids.description: contradiction_id values from findings.json that this section reports
